title: Two fixes: claude -p in cloud sessions, many MCP tools
headline: claude -p works inside cloud sessions without their environment variables, and sessions with many MCP tools keep their real API errors.

lines.text: Inside a cloud session, claude -p started without the session's environment variables no longer claims you are not logged in.
In sessions with many MCP tools, an API error is no longer replaced by "prompt is too long" followed by a compaction that wasn't needed.
